title: Affine cartesian determinant interfaces and compatible local exterior formulas
statement: Fix normalized derived pullback coherence [lem-trf-two-term-determinant-pullback-coherence]. TwoTermDeterminantFunctorData is the determinant-functor and cartesian-comparison part of [def-trf-two-term-determinant-data], with the already proved source-membership assertions [lem-trf-two-term-perfect-tor-window] and the fixed coherence supplied separately. AffineTwoTermDeterminantData asks for the functors and cartesian comparisons only on affine schemes and maps of affines. In addition it records, for any displayed model P on any scheme X and any affine f:Y→X, an isomorphism from f*P.line to the affine determinant of Lf*P, compatible with further affine pullback. It records the analogous unit isomorphisms for zero and one global contractible-to-zero isomorphism whose pullbacks satisfy the evaluation equation on every affine test scheme. These last families ensure that the exterior, zero and evaluation comparisons can actually be glued; bare unrelated objectwise comparisons would not suffice.

source.place: Tag 0FJM and its scalar-extension construction; perfect.tex Tags 0FJX and 0FJY.

proof.text: Separate the fixed coherent derived comparisons from the determinant functor fields. Restrict the latter to affine test schemes, and retain the natural exterior-power and zero families under a further affine morphism. Write their coherence and evaluation equations explicitly.

For the Tor-window search, DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isGE_of_isLE gives a cohomologically bounded complex, without finite locally free terms. The existing finite-free residue model in our library supplies the stronger input.
Zero hits. The separate "Perfect", "Tor" query returned unrelated perfect groups, perfect closures and graph matchings.

Two hits in Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Complex/Determinant.lean concern complex numbers, not complexes. The additional leftAdjointCompIso search found the mate/composition API used in the proved normalized-coherence argument. No determinant construction was found.

mathlib_searches.query: Determinant line of two term perfect complexes compatible with affine base change and descent
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: LinearMap.det, IsBaseChange.det_endHom, LinearEquiv.det_baseChange, LinearMap.det_baseChange and related scalar determinants. These are endomorphism determinants, not determinant lines of complexes or compatible gluing data. The queried theorem types do not provide the required construction.
